title: GRM: a Global Relational Model (grm-core)
description:
GRM is a solver for networks of relations: every quantity is a node, every law a relation (an elastic), and the network settles where all of them hold together (weighted least squares in log space, Gauss-Newton and Levenberg-Marquardt, continuation, covariance, leave-one-out, emergence of missing nodes).

This archive contains the Python engine and its applications: an explorer for networks of relations with a bank of known constants, a test of hidden-node emergence, the Relational Universe (a 3D web simulation from the Big Bang to the end of time in which every number is held by one GRM network, with a faithful JavaScript port of the engine), and two exploratory studies of the particle masses: grm_tao.py (harmonic cascades from two seeds, judged against random spectra) and grm_loop.py (a loop without a seed: the full and the void in balance, equivalent to Koide's relation).

A dated prediction is included (predictions/2026-11-04-loop-neutrinos.md): from the measured neutrino mass-squared differences alone, the loop gives the normal mass ordering and a sum of neutrino masses of 59.35 ± 0.30 meV (m1 ≈ 0.37 meV), written before the measurements that will decide it.

From version 0.2.0: a second bet on the Cantor cascade (neutrino phase 13/27, giving Δm²21 = (7.667 ± 0.087) × 10-5 eV², with its first check against JUNO), and four bets that follow from the same masses: the tau mass (1776.969 MeV), the mass seen in beta decay (8.84 meV), neutrinoless double beta decay (mββ between 1.1 and 4.1 meV) and the cosmological sum (59.35 meV). All are in the folder predictions/.

From version 0.3.0: the engine is published on its own as pygrm (pip install pygrm), and the folder equation/ holds one network of 199 known quantities (cosmology, Planck units, atoms, planets, a guitar, a voice) in which the GRM brings up S × Equant = Estock (the entropy of the horizon times the energy of its temperature equals the energy filling it), traces the seven relations it combines to reach it, and tests it against Cosmicflows-4, DESI DR2 and the curvature of the universe. The equation is the vacuum equilibrium of Padmanabhan's holographic equipartition; what is shown is that the network finds it by itself, and how.
